title: Redwick Components | Transfer notes for the latch order
titleZh: 雷德威克零件公司｜門扣訂單交接備忘
passage:
The evening crew found marks on the latches at the end of packing. The latch travels flat during molding and inspection, then upright through the feeder before it reaches the packing table, where it lies flat again. In the case of these marks, the streak narrows toward the end that was leading when the contact occurred.

I asked each station to mark the leading end of an unmarked latch with blue chalk before moving it. The crew’s photographs show that the hinge end leads while a latch lies flat; the free end leads when it is upright in the feeder. On the latch with the streak the streak starts near the hinge and tapers toward the free end. The final packing check had been made on the box exterior only.

Purchase orders for the clear divider were split between two suppliers. In the cost log, charge a replacement divider to the supplier of the original only when that original was unusable on arrival. If it was accepted, then damaged while we were setting a tray up, charge the replacement to in-house setup. Enter the replacement against the item involved, not against the box or the order as a whole.

The carton was stamped Northpack, but it contained dividers from both suppliers. The completion sheet identifies dividers by notch pattern, not by the carton: one notch means Northpack and two mean Elsin. At delivery, the receiving team checked every divider before accepting it or moving it to setup. Only dividers rejected as unusable at that first check went beyond the taped line, where they stayed.

A photo taken during the first receiving check shows the cracked two-notch divider beyond the taped line. Another photo shows the one-notch divider in use at setup; its receiving record was signed as usable, and the setup lead reported that it broke during a tray adjustment. We replaced both from our spare shelf.
passageZh:
晚班人員在包裝完成時發現門扣上有刮痕。門扣在成形與檢查時是平放的，接著以直立姿態通過送料裝置，抵達包裝桌後再度平放。這一類細痕會朝接觸當時位於前方的門扣端部變窄。

我請各工站先在一件沒有痕跡的門扣前端畫上藍色粉筆記號，再移動它。現場照片顯示，門扣平放時是鉸接端在前；在送料裝置中直立時則是自由端在前。那件有細痕的門扣上，細痕從鉸接端附近開始，朝自由端變窄。包裝最後的檢查只看了盒子外觀。

透明隔板的採購訂單分給兩家供應商。按成本紀錄規則，只有原隔板到貨時就不能使用，才將更換費用記在原隔板的供應商名下。如果隔板已驗收，後來才在我們架設托盤時受損，更換費用應列入內部架設成本。請按實際更換的品項入帳，不要以整盒或整張訂單為單位。

外箱蓋的是 Northpack 印記，但兩家供應商的隔板都放在裡面。作業完成紀錄以凹口數辨識隔板，不看外箱印記：一個凹口代表 Northpack，兩個代表 Elsin。到貨時，收貨人員會在驗收或搬去架設前，先檢查每一片隔板。只有在初檢時因不能使用而遭拒收的隔板，才會放在膠帶標線外，並留在那裡。

到貨初檢時拍攝的照片顯示，有裂痕且有兩個凹口的隔板放在膠帶標線外。另一張照片顯示有一個凹口的隔板已用於架設；收貨紀錄上已簽收為可用，而架設領班回報它是在調整托盤時斷裂。兩片的更換品都來自備品架。
